items.rationale: Proposer claims 100 distinct committers in 12mo, but the repo is a standard Apache project; 100 is a suspiciously round number and likely a placeholder. A quick check of recent commits shows a few active maintainers, not 100 distinct ones.

summary: Challenged the suspiciously round number for distinct_committers_12mo. Other metrics (bug history, testability) were verified and matched.
